svg.data-renderer: Matplotlib MathText / STIX; embedded vector paths
svg.title: Toggling an augmenting path
svg.desc: Before toggling, two blue matching edges alternate with three red unmatched edges along a path. After toggling, the three formerly unmatched edges form a larger matching.
Figure labels: Before: |M| = 2; After toggling: |M △ E(P)| = 3; x₁; x₂; x₃; y₁; y₂; y₃; x₁; x₂; x₃; y₁; y₂; y₃; blue = M; red dashed = E(P) \ M; green = enlarged matching
